name: Website
blurb: The business's public website, ready on its own machine: a Hono site with a brand folder, a design system file, and one command that publishes it to the edge. Build it from the brand, or from a site the owner points at.
directive: The Website Starter App is installed. The app in ~/app is now a Hono website: brand/ (the brand as markdown notes; BRAND.md), public/ (the fact notes with typed frontmatter; FACTS.md), posts/ and legal/ (collections), site-map.md (the page plan and migration ledger), styles/theme.css (the design tokens), src/site.ts (the site's facts), DESIGN.md (the identity block, the design rules, and the procedure for updating from the brand), src/pages (the pages), and it is serving from this machine as the `web` service (npm run dev on port 3000; check with `sprite-env services get web`). Its skills are in ~/app/.claude/skills: website (build and run the site: pages, brand, images, forms, seo.md, posts.md), design and writing (the brief, the style catalogue in .claude/skills/design/styles with a preview per style and `npm run style -- <name>` to apply one, three directions, the voice card, the copy bar, the copy gate in npm run check), migrate-site (take over an existing site: inventory, facts, brand, page map, pages, redirects, launch), site-facts (the fact notes when there is no Company Brain), launch-check (the old URLs against the new site), ship (publish to the edge with `npm run deploy`). Start by reading .claude/skills/website/SKILL.md and ~/app/DESIGN.md, confirm the site answers on the machine, then ask the owner two things: does the business have a current website (if so, the migrate-site skill leads and its two questions come first: keep the URLs, faithful or redesign), and is there a Company Brain in this project (tools.taskandtool.project_apps; if so, the brain reads the site and writes the notes, and the owner mirrors brain/brand onto brand, brain/public onto public, and brain/raw/web onto raw/web from this app's Settings before you design). Do not invent facts, customers, or prices; reserve honest slots for what does not exist yet. Publishing to the web is the owner's dashboard action.

suggestions.label: Build my website
suggestions.prompt: Build my website. First ask me what you need to know about the business, who the site is for, and what a visitor should do; then write what you learn into the notes in brand/ (positioning, voice, visual identity) and public/business.md, set styles/theme.css, src/site.ts, and DESIGN.md from them, propose three design directions per the design skill, and build the home page from real content. Show me the working copy when it is ready. Here is what we do:

suggestions.label: Pick a style for my site
suggestions.prompt: Help me pick a style for the site from the design skill's catalogue (.claude/skills/design/styles). Attach the six preview.png files to your reply with attach_files from tools/taskandtool.py so I can click through them, name each preset in one line (its thesis and what it suits), and ask me which is closest or what blend I want. Then apply it with npm run style, run 'Updating from the brand' in DESIGN.md with my brand notes, screenshot the home page at 1280 and 390 wide, attach the screenshots, and ask me what to change. The kind of business and feel I want:

suggestions.label: Read my current website
suggestions.prompt: Read my current website with the migrate-site skill: ask me the two questions first (keep the URLs? faithful rebuild or redesign?), then crawl it with tt-crawl into raw/web with styles and screenshots, fetch the documents it links to, detect WordPress, and report what you found: pages, forms, embeds, tracking IDs, and whether you hit the page limit. My site is

suggestions.label: Mirror my brain's notes here
suggestions.prompt: This project has a Company Brain. Check with project_apps that it is there, then walk me through mirroring, from this app's Settings, its brain/brand folder onto brand, brain/public onto public, and brain/raw/web onto raw/web (read-only copies). Once they have synced, tell me what the notes hold and what they still lack that only I can supply.

suggestions.label: Extract the facts from my site
suggestions.prompt: Extract the facts from my crawled site with the site-facts skill: seed public/business.md from raw/structured, fill services, faq, team, policies, and proof from the pages and linked documents, copy legal text verbatim into legal/, then run npm run content and npm run check. Tell me every fact you could not find and every conflict you saw.

suggestions.label: Apply my brand from my site
suggestions.prompt: Apply the brand to this site from my crawled site: first write brand/visual-identity.md (colours as hex, fonts, the logo files copied into brand/logo/) and positioning.md from raw/web/_styles.json, _media.json, and the pages, then. Follow DESIGN.md's 'Updating from the brand': colours and fonts into styles/theme.css with roles assigned and contrast checked, the facts into src/site.ts, then DESIGN.md's palette, type, and Identity block. Show me the result on the working copy and list what the notes did not say that only I can supply.

suggestions.label: Apply my brand from the brain
suggestions.prompt: Apply the brand to this site from the Company Brain's notes mirrored into brand/. Follow DESIGN.md's 'Updating from the brand': colours and fonts into styles/theme.css with roles assigned and contrast checked, the facts into src/site.ts, then DESIGN.md's palette, type, and Identity block. Show me the result on the working copy and list what the notes did not say that only I can supply.

suggestions.label: Plan the new site
suggestions.prompt: Plan the new site in site-map.md from raw/web/_inventory.json and _furniture.json: one row per old URL (keep, merge, drop) and per new page, the redirect targets, the notes each page draws on, the nav and footer architecture, and anything out of scope. Apply the migrate-site rules (existing redirects kept, noindex never kept, posts as a collection, every form reproduced or dropped on purpose). Propose it all in one message and wait for my decisions.

suggestions.label: Build the next page
suggestions.prompt: Build the next planned page in site-map.md from the notes in public/ and brand/, in the site's design, with the old page's raw markdown open for what it said and which links it carried (keep the words in a faithful rebuild). Follow seo.md, mark the row built, show me the working copy, and stop for my review.

suggestions.label: Update pages whose facts changed
suggestions.prompt: The notes in public/ changed after the pages were last built. Read site-map.md's notes column to find the pages that draw on the changed notes, update them, run npm run content and npm run check, and show me what changed and where.

suggestions.label: Check the launch
suggestions.prompt: Run the launch-check skill against the working copy: npm run check, npm run build, then tt-crawl check against localhost:3000 with raw/web/_inventory.json. Fix what it finds, re-run until clean, and show me the report as a table with what changed.

suggestions.label: Fix the site audit findings
suggestions.prompt: The weekly site audit found issues. Read raw/web/_audit.md, fix everything in the site's control (broken internal links, missing titles or descriptions, a page without one h1, images without alt text, redirect chains), tell me about anything outside it, then rebuild, deploy with the ship skill, and re-run tt-crawl audit to confirm.

suggestions.label: Add a page
suggestions.prompt: Add a page to the site. Follow the website skill: a new module in src/pages, listed in src/pages/index.ts, a row in site-map.md, in the nav if it belongs there, built from the design system and real copy. The page is

suggestions.label: Add a blog post
suggestions.prompt: Add a blog post to posts/ following the website skill's posts.md: frontmatter with title, date, description, and a path if it replaces an old URL; the body through the writing skill's voice card; a real photo if I have one. The post is about

suggestions.label: Add a contact form
suggestions.prompt: Add a contact form following the website skill's forms.md: a leads table on the project's database (ask me to enable Postgres with request_capability if this app has none), the POST route with a honeypot and a redirect to a thank-you page, and the form on the contact page. Tell me how I will be notified of a submission.

suggestions.label: Publish to the edge
suggestions.prompt: Publish the site with the ship skill: run the checks, build, deploy to the edge with npm run deploy, verify the public URL, and remind me where the on-the-web setting lives. Tell me if edge serving is not enabled for this app yet.

suggestions.label: Add my Google listing
suggestions.prompt: Add my public Google listing: run tt-crawl places for my business (ask me for a Google Places connection with request_connection if this app has no GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY), then fold the phone, address, hours, and the public reviews into public/business.md and public/proof.md with raw/places as the source, run npm run content, and show me the contact section and the proof strip on the working copy.
